metrics.name: new_customers
metrics.formula: COUNT DISTINCT resolved customers whose first_purchase_date = reporting day
metrics.limitations: NULL com history_complete=false.

metrics.name: returning_customers
metrics.formula: COUNT DISTINCT resolved customers whose first_purchase_date < reporting day
metrics.limitations: Não duplica aquisição com recompra no mesmo dia.

metrics.name: purchase_frequency
metrics.formula: qualifying resolved orders in interval / active resolved customers in interval
metrics.limitations: Unidade pedidos/cliente no período explícito.

metrics.name: customer_repurchase_rate
metrics.formula: active customers with >=2 observed purchases before period end / active customers
metrics.limitations: NULL sem cobertura histórica completa; inclui primeira compra anterior ao período.

metrics.name: customer_retention_rate
metrics.formula: intersection(current active customers, previous active customers) / previous active customers
metrics.limitations: Baseline anterior de igual quantidade de dias locais; NULL sem cobertura completa.
